notice.rateLoop: MANUAL bypasses PID, RATE uses the rate loop, and ANGLE uses both angle and rate loops.

profile.heading: Configuration Sharing
profile.description: Export or import PWM, mixer, PID and board orientation settings. Importing only fills the configurator forms and never writes to the receiver.
profile.unsaved: Imported values are staged in the configurator. Use the existing Save button on the PWM and Flight pages to write each section to the receiver.
profile.offlineReady: The profile is loaded offline and can be viewed or exported again. Connect a receiver before saving.

profile.flightUnsaved: Imported flight-control values are not saved. Review them, then press Save to write them to the receiver.
profile.targetWarning: The profile target is {source}, while the connected target is {target}; review all values before saving.
profile.pwmPartialWarning: The profile contains {source} PWM outputs; the remaining outputs on this {target}-output receiver were left unchanged.

pwm.heading: PWM Output
pwm.noPwmNotice: This target does not expose PWM outputs through /config.
pwm.offlineNotice: Not connected to a device. This is an offline preview; connect a receiver before saving.

help.general: Configure each receiver output pin mode, source channel, inversion, pulse width and failsafe. Invert mirrors the control value around 1500us. Polarity stores the raw signal-polarity flag; whether it has an effect depends on the current platform and output mode. Modes above Serial RX/TX are exclusive and can only be assigned once.
help.serial2: Shown when any output is assigned to Serial2 TX.

limits.heading: Servo travel
limits.help: Set each 50–500Hz PWM output's minimum, center and maximum pulse. Values are applied independently on either side of center for both RC and mixer sources; non-PWM modes and failsafe pulses are unchanged.

wifiOutput.heading: WiFi real-time PWM test
wifiOutput.label: Enable PWM output in WiFi mode
wifiOutput.help: Runtime only and reset to off at every power-up. Each time it is enabled, all sliders return to their current configured center values for real-time testing.

flight.heading: Flight Control
flight.wifiRangeHelp: When the AUX condition matches, WiFi starts without stopping the ELRS radio link. Otherwise the receiver safely falls back to RF-only mode.
flight.wifiCoexistDescription: Keep the ELRS radio link active while enabling WiFi for live MSP debugging
flight.rangeHelp: RATE and ANGLE are optional independent AUX conditions and may share a channel. ANGLE wins if both are active; otherwise MANUAL is used.
flight.rateDescription: Rate mode using the Rate PID
flight.angleDescription: Self-level mode using Angle and Rate PID
flight.armDescription: Use a dedicated switch to arm the motors
flight.armRangeDescription: Armed while the channel is inside this range
flight.ratePidHelp: Inner-loop angular-rate control for RATE and ANGLE modes.
flight.angleRateLimitsHelp: Limits the Roll and Pitch angular-rate targets produced by the outer angle loop. Default: 100°/s per axis.
flight.anglePidHelp: Outer-loop attitude control used only in ANGLE mode.
flight.dtermLpfHelp: Applied globally to Rate and Angle PID. Use 5–100Hz, or 0 to disable filtering. Default: 20Hz.
flight.filterSettingsHelp: Configure gyro input and D-term low-pass filtering in one place.
flight.gyroLpfHelp: Filters all three gyro axes before attitude estimation and PID. Use 5–100Hz, or 0 to disable filtering. Default: 30Hz.
flight.mixerHelp: Map throttle and axis corrections to each motor or servo output.
flight.mixerServoHelp: Servo outputs use center as the zero-mix baseline. Unchecked outputs behave as motors starting at minimum throttle. Servos remain active while the ARM switch is off.

orient.heading: Two-face Board Orientation Calibration
orient.description: Identify the nearest 90° board orientation, then use the level pose for continuous roll and pitch correction.
orient.safety: Remove the propellers and secure the flight controller. For the first top-up step, the complete aircraft must rest normally on a level table or level ground—do not hold it or follow only the arrow printed on the controller.
orient.topUpInstruction: Step 1: place the complete aircraft normally, top up, on a level table or level ground. Confirm it is level and completely still before sampling.
orient.noseUpInstruction: Step 2: stand the aircraft on its tail with the nose pointing vertically upward. Secure it and keep it completely still before sampling.
orient.topCaptured: The level top-up pose is captured. Stand the aircraft on its tail with the nose pointing vertically upward.
orient.complete: Two-face orientation calibration is complete. Horizon correction: roll={roll}°, pitch={pitch}°. Save will write the 3×3 rotation matrix.
orient.ready: Both faces are captured. Horizon correction: roll={roll}°, pitch={pitch}°. Review the installation angles below.
orient.resultReadOnly: Calculated from the orientation matrix; read-only
orient.topUpPoseHelp: The complete aircraft must rest normally on a level table or level ground, top up. Do not calibrate while holding it.
orient.noseUpPoseHelp: Secure the aircraft on its tail with the nose pointing vertically upward and keep it still.
orient.saveHelp: Yaw uses the nearest 90° orientation; roll and pitch use continuous horizon correction. Reboot before running six-face accelerometer calibration.

imuCalibration.heading: IMU Calibration
imuCalibration.safety: Remove the propellers and keep the flight controller still. Calibration uses aircraft-frame data after the saved orientation TF; save and reboot first if board orientation was changed.
imuCalibration.accelDescription: Place the aircraft steadily on all six faces in any order. The configurator identifies each orientation from gravity.
imuCalibration.gyroDescription: Sample stationary angular rates to calculate and save the three-axis bias. Calibration does not run automatically at boot.
imuCalibration.nextFace: Next: place the sensor with {face}, let it settle, then select that face.
imuCalibration.autoFaceHint: Place the controller steadily on any unfinished face, then select Next. The configurator will identify its orientation from gravity.
imuCalibration.detectingFace: Detecting the current orientation and sampling. Keep the controller still…
imuCalibration.accelReady: All six faces are captured. The calculated values are shown below.
imuCalibration.sampling: Sampling—do not move the flight controller…
imuCalibration.keepStill: Place the flight controller level and still
imuCalibration.gyroDuration: Sampling takes about 2 seconds; do not touch the device
imuCalibration.saveHelp: After calibration, press Save to persist the values and apply them to the IMU data path immediately.
imuCalibration.faceCaptured: Captured {face}. Continue with the next face.
imuCalibration.accelComplete: Six-face accelerometer calibration is complete. Review the values and press Save.
imuCalibration.gyroComplete: Gyroscope calibration is complete. Review the values and press Save.

pidlog.heading: PID plots
pidlog.description: Start capture to actively poll the flight controller over MSP. No CH6 switch is required, and samples are neither filled nor interpolated.
pidlog.chartHelp: Rate plots include samples from both RATE and ANGLE flight modes. Angle plots show Roll and Pitch in ANGLE mode. Each plot supports independent history, zoom, and sample inspection.
pidlog.liveHelp: Hiding a series only stops rendering it; captured samples remain in memory.
